sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='resting' AND created_at < now() - interval '4 hours') AS stuck_past_timeout, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='resting') AS resting_now, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancel_reason='timeout' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS timeout_ok_24h, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cancel_reason='drain_unconfirmed' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS drain_unconf_24h, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='rejected' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS rejected_24h, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '2 hours') AS orders_2h FROM live_orders
